name: volvox_lab
frame: FR20 base (URDF): Z up from the base's mounting face; the arm's zero pose points along -X, which is the robot's working front; metres
source: MEASURED 2026-09-25 on the real FR20: floor (level), left partition and TV wall (vertical fits) with scripts/probe_ui.py; ceiling grid by tape (2.16 m); tv, furniture_back (side table), control_cart, shelves_right, back and right walls from a RoomPlan scan (Project-2609251250.usdz) aligned to the probed walls with scripts/scan_to_env.py (the two walls agree to 0.47 deg). The room is square and the arm is mounted turned ~11 deg on a plate that is square to it. The plant and the operator's place marked by the user on a screenshot (+-0.2 m). Still ESTIMATED: the plant's size, base_plate size.

objects.name: floor
objects.note: level, at the one floor point probed with the flange flat (tilt 2 deg): z -0.0048. The two taken with the flange tilted ~7 deg read 1-2 cm high (the rim touches first) -- a pointed probe tool would remove this. The floor cannot be above the plate the base stands on (z 0).

objects.name: base_plate
objects.note: the plate the base is bolted to: square to the room, the arm on it turned ~11 deg (user, 2026-09-25); size and centre still estimated. The upper-arm capsule runs ~6 cm fat near it, so no extra margin

objects.name: ceiling
objects.note: lowest point of the load-bearing grid under the ceiling: 2.16 m by tape (2026-09-25); the ceiling itself is 2.38 m (RoomPlan scan). The raised arm reaches 2.16 m: this plane is in play
